name: toolward
description: Security auditor for AI agent extensions: MCP servers, skills, plugins and connectors. Static analysis, never executes what it audits.
author: AIjentra (https://aijentra.com)

scripts.prepack: npm run clean && npm run build
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test test/i18n.test.js test/lock.test.js test/parse.test.js test/rules.test.js test/score.test.js
scripts.test:only: node --test test/i18n.test.js test/lock.test.js test/parse.test.js test/rules.test.js test/score.test.js
scripts.selfscan: npm run build && node dist/cli.js scan examples/vulnerable --fail-on none
scripts.docs:rules: npm run build && node dist/cli.js rules --format md > docs/rules.md && node dist/cli.js rules --format md --lang zh > docs/rules.zh-CN.md
